passport.format: Voluntary digital product passport. Laid out like the content the EU Joint Research Centre proposed for textile apparel in May 2026 (Study on DPP content for textile apparel products under ESPR). Not yet required by law.
passport.dataCarrier: NFC tag in the jacket (opens nike.lucasfmiller.com)

toConfirm.note: Keep the iron off the vinyl pockets

beforeWashing: Unplug both sleeve motors from the radar unit
Take the radar unit off the jacket
afterWashing: Let the jacket dry completely before plugging the motors back in
notes: The sleeve motors are sealed and stay in the jacket

removable.contains: 24 GHz radar (LD2450), ESP32-C3 controller, motion sensor (MPU-6050)

stayIn.note: Sealed coin vibration motors on leads that plug into the radar unit (L and R)

electronics.radio: Bluetooth Low Energy and Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) from the controller; 24 GHz radar

repair: Each motor plugs into the radar unit (L and R), so either one can be swapped on its own
endOfLife: Radar unit and motors: electrical waste (WEEE) collection, not textile recycling
Jacket: textile collection once the motors and their leads are taken out
